files.description: Main EHI export documentation page (Sphinx-generated HTML). Describes single-patient and population export workflows, export file format (NDJSON + attachments), and links to the data dictionary.

Complete EHI export data dictionary in XLS format. 84 sheets covering 81 data sections with 960 fields total. Includes INDEX, Changelogs, and per-section field definitions (column name, data type, nullable, description). Last updated November 2025.

Qualifacts EHI Export Terms of Use (September 2024). 3-page PDF governing conditions for receiving EHI exports, including usage restrictions, disclaimers, and liability limitations. Required acceptance for population exports.
Bun TypeScript enrichment script that parses the XLS data dictionary into queryable JSON. Extracts all 81 data sections with field-level metadata, changelogs, and INDEX classification.

Enrichment output: complete machine-queryable JSON extraction of all 81 data sections and 960 fields from the XLS data dictionary. Includes section metadata (category, module), field definitions (name, type, nullable, description), and changelog history.
Enrichment output: parse accounting showing 84 total sheets, 81 parsed, 0 failures, and per-section field count summary.
Enrichment documentation: run commands, input boundary, output files, and known parsing limitations.
